answer_1.quote: We propose a Diversity-oriented data Augmentation approach (DoAug) using an LLM to paraphrase sentences.
answer_1.outputs: Generated paraphrased sentences for data augmentation

answer_2.quote: We adopt several measurements to assess the augmented dataset's diversity from both latent and lexical aspects: • Distance and Dispersion ... • Isocontour Radius and Homogeneity ... • Vocabulary Size and Unique 3-grams ... Affinity ...

answer_3.quote: We also prompt the DeepSeek-V3 model, a very strong and knowledgeable LLM that is good at understanding users' intent and evaluating the task scenario for an LLM-based evaluation.

answer_4.quote: We perform a human evaluation on 200 samples per dataset to check if the paraphrases are semantically similar to the original samples and adhere to the original labels.
answer_4.guideline: to check if the paraphrases are semantically similar to the original samples and adhere to the original labels
